description: This file defines the OpenClawBonjour enum, which contains constants and utility methods for handling Bonjour service domains, including functions for resolving and normalizing domain strings within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: resolveWideAreaDomain
methods.description: Resolves the wide area domain from a raw environment variable string, trimming whitespace and checking for empty or default values, returning normalized domain if applicable.

methods.name: normalizeServiceDomain
methods.description: Normalizes a service domain string by trimming whitespace, converting to lowercase, and appending a trailing dot if necessary, with special handling for 'local' and empty strings.
